_readme: STAGING for the Wave-3 merge agent. VerifyCheckbox (brainstorm #3). Merge sharedPrompts into ALL FOUR banks/<niche>.json (shr_ prefix = identical id in every bank, one VO clip each via q_<id>). Then apply nicheOverrides per niche (the GRADING INVERSION: est/deep/cli answer flips to false for drone+circe). The visible checkbox CAPTION is NOT in the bank - it comes from the module STRINGS[niche] table in render/captcha/checkbox.js; prompt.text is the SPOKEN VO line only (niche-agnostic so one bambi-voiced clip serves all four). Recovery (shr_cap_check_rec) is authored here for a later wave: the engine hardcodes Recovery lines today and will not select a bank prompt in the Recovery band until that wiring lands - the module's Recovery render path is implemented and waiting.

sharedPrompts.text: Confirm you are human. Check the box to verify.
Press and hold the box until verification completes.
Keep holding. Verification is still in progress.
flavors: Keep holding, it is still working.

sharedPrompts.text: Hold steady. Let it verify you completely.
flavors: Hold steady and let it finish.

sharedPrompts.text: Your verification is already on file. It is permanent.

sfxWanted.why: soft rising tone under the press-and-hold fill (module currently reuses existing 'sticker-drag' throttled per RAF tick); a dedicated cue would read cleaner. gain ~0.15, loop false, request-at-floor 0.5s then trim.
the moment the check greens (hold completes / calibration click). Module reuses 'surface-bloom' today. gain ~0.45, loop false.
optional soft tick as the box first fills; low priority. gain ~0.2, loop false.

voExtra.why: OPTIONAL spoken climax verdict stinger if a designer wants it; the module does NOT call audio.voice today (verdict is the chrome.stamp only). Would need an audio.voice() call site + manifest entry per CAPTCHA_HANDOFF.md 3.
voExtra.niche: one bambi voice for all, per primer 1

voExtra.why: OPTIONAL spoken refusal verdict; same wiring caveat. circe register would need its own cold variant if this is ever voiced per-niche.

notes: FOR WAVE-3 MERGE. 1) Grading inversion is the whole trick: bambi/sissy keep answer=true across cal/est/deep/cli (checking the affirmation = compliance). drone+circe FLIP est/deep/cli to answer=false via nicheOverrides (their caption states what CHECKING asserts, and that assertion is the REFUSAL, so NOT-checking+verify is compliance). Calibration stays answer=true for ALL FOUR (the item plays 100% straight to build trust; the inversion only bites from Establishing on). Recovery answer=true for all (pre-checked, permanent). 2) Committing true always costs the hold; false is one VERIFY/decline press away -> both answers, incl. refusal, always completable (invariant 1). 3) Tags: only heat>=2 votes axes (IntakeProfiler.MinHeat=2), so cal/rec are inert by design; est/deep/cli vote A2 Service (compliance/obedience/surrender) + A1 Blankness (sinking/dropping/blank/erasure) - meaningful in all four banks. 'verify'/'captcha' are inert markers (not in any axis/structural set). No disqualifying tags (trivia/colorpick/trick) used, so these records count. 4) cli is heat 4 (h5 fact respected: still requires band=climax); bump to 5 if you want it pooled only at peak. 5) VO text is niche-agnostic on purpose (one bambi clip per shr_ id via the ccp-trailer q_<id> pipeline); the verbatim guard in build_intake_manifest.py will assert generated v3 == these strings. 6) Module owns captions/labels/verdicts (STRINGS table) and the injected CSS ('ix-captcha-checkbox-css'); nothing here touches styles.css. 7) If Recovery-band bank consumption is wired later, shr_cap_check_rec is ready; until then it is dormant (engine hardcodes Recovery).
